backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining products, carts, orders, user profiles, and admin authorization with storage mixins and role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related frontend files, components, and test IDs for verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and major functionality across pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router defining customer/admin routes, auth guards, admin auto-redirect logic, and root layout setup.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Dialog displaying detailed order information including status, timestamps, customer principal, and item breakdown.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen informing users they must log in, showing supported login methods and navigation buttons to login or home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that handles Internet Identity authentication state and triggers login or clear actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog prompting new users to enter profile details and submit them via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/catalog/Categori: Displays categories as a featured grid plus a scrollable list, with icons, selection handling, and styled cards.
frontend/src/components/catalog/category: Maps category names to Lucide icons and provides a helper to fetch the correct icon.
frontend/src/components/hero/Hero3D.tsx: Three.js-based 3D hero section rendering floating grocery items with animations respecting reduced-motion settings.
frontend/src/components/KiranaBrandHeade: Header component with branding, navigation links, cart badge, admin button, theme toggle, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Theme toggle button switching between light and dark modes using next-themes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook detecting the user's reduced-motion preference using a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user auth, profiles, bootstrap admin email, and product/order operations via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and warm-themed OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Defines the admin panel layout with navigation, mobile sidebar, header, and theming controls.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DashboardPage.t: Shows admin dashboard stats for products and orders and allows editing the bootstrap admin email.
frontend/src/pages/admin/InventoryPage.t: Empty placeholder file for the Inventory admin page.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Displays and filters orders, allows updating order status, and opens detailed order dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductsPage.ts: Provides UI for listing, searching, adding, editing, and deleting products with stock management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StaffPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the Staff admin page.
frontend/src/pages/admin/SuppliersPage.t: Empty placeholder file for the Suppliers admin page.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Implements a login page supporting Internet Identity, email/password, and OTP flows with redirect logic based on user role.
frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingModePa: Empty file placeholder for billing mode selection UI.
frontend/src/pages/customer/AboutPage.ts: Renders an About page with store history, values, and a hero section with imagery and icons.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with item management, quantity updates, clearing options, and navigation to checkout.
Shows product listings with search, category filtering, a hero section, and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CheckoutPage: Provides checkout form for delivery info and places orders based on cart contents.
Renders a contact page with store details and a non‑functional contact form.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CustomerLayo: Provides the main customer-facing layout with header, content outlet, and a footer containing brand info, quick links, and social icons.
frontend/src/pages/customer/GoalsPage.ts: Displays the store's mission, goals, and an illustrative image using cards and icon sections.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrderConfirm: Shows a confirmation message for a placed order with options to track the order, view all orders, or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrdersPage.t: Lists all customer orders with status indicators and navigation to individual order details.
frontend/src/pages/customer/OrderTrackin: Loads and displays detailed status information for a specific order with refresh and navigation options.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color palette, extended theme settings, and typography/container/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current system state, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions for the kirana platform.
